metadata.description: Personal skill toolkit: DAX, data engineering, KPI, data storytelling, prompt engineering, Python architecture, code smells (Designite-style), Impatient Programming, skill management, YouTube/article-to-skill converters and the skills made with them (dbt, MCP security, SaaS strategy, server capacity, SQL indexing)

plugins.name: writing-dax-measures
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug DAX measures for Power BI and Analysis Services. Use for new calculations, time intelligence, filter context bugs, or slow measures.

plugins.name: etl-pipeline-design
plugins.description: Design, evaluate, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT pipelines. Use for ingestion, orchestration, batch vs streaming, medallion layers, or a failing pipeline.

plugins.name: kpi-checklists
plugins.description: Define and implement KPIs, from strategy to a live dashboard. Use when designing a KPI system, scorecard, KPI tree, or management reporting.

plugins.name: skill-finder
plugins.description: Find skills, plugins, and MCP servers for a task by searching GitHub and marketplaces. Use when you lack a tool for something.

plugins.name: skill-curator
plugins.description: Audit, improve, and maintain a skill library: duplicates, overlaps, gaps, and conflicts. Use when reviewing installed skills.

plugins.name: skill-publisher
plugins.description: Package a skill repo for the Claude Code marketplace and skills.sh, then open a PR. Use when publishing a skill or adding install support.

plugins.name: channel-artifact
plugins.description: Build interactive localhost HTML artifacts wired to a live Claude Code session through a channel plugin. Use when you want a UI you can pin questions on.

plugins.name: humanitys-last-prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Prompt engineering techniques, role templates, and scoring frameworks. Use when writing, fixing, or improving a prompt.

plugins.name: improve-system
plugins.description: Review your agent setup, capture learnings, audit for rot, and recap sessions. Run regularly to keep your setup improving.

plugins.name: arjancodes-playbook
plugins.description: Pythonic design patterns, clean architecture, typing, and testing (from ArjanCodes). Use when choosing or implementing a design pattern in Python.

plugins.name: data-storytelling
plugins.description: Critique and build charts, slides, and data presentations around audience and message. Use when reviewing a chart or deck, or planning a data story.

plugins.name: quality-pass
plugins.description: One-command quality pass that sends each changed file to the best installed review skill. Use after changing code and before committing.

plugins.name: youtube-to-skill
plugins.description: Turn YouTube videos, playlists, or channels into agent skills, or answer questions about a video. Use when sharing a YouTube link.

plugins.name: article-to-skill
plugins.description: Turn articles, blog posts, and docs pages into agent skills, or answer questions about an article. Use when sharing an article or blog URL.

plugins.name: dbt-agent-context
plugins.description: Give AI agents the business context they need to answer questions over a dbt project. Use for text-to-SQL or BI agents that give wrong or inconsistent answers.

plugins.name: dbt-agentic-dev
plugins.description: Design and review agent workflows that write, test, and ship dbt models, from prompt to validated PR. Use when building or reviewing AI-driven dbt development.

plugins.name: dbt-compute-cost
plugins.description: Cut dbt warehouse spend and run time with dbt State, right-sizing, and v2 tooling. Use when dbt runs or CI are slow or expensive, or planning a v2 migration.

plugins.name: mcp-security
plugins.description: Review and harden MCP servers, clients, and agent tool setups (OWASP MCP Top 10). Use when building, installing, or auditing an MCP server or agent config.

plugins.name: saas-ai-moats
plugins.description: Score how well a SaaS business can survive AI: 10 attacks and 8 moats that still work. Use when judging a SaaS idea, product, or acquisition target.

plugins.name: server-capacity-tuning
plugins.description: Find what limits a small server's capacity and pick the fixes that raise it. Use for load testing, capacity planning, or EMFILE, OOM, and iowait problems.

plugins.name: go-observability
plugins.description: Review and build logs, metrics, alerts, profiles, and traces for Go services. Use when adding or auditing observability in a Go service.

plugins.name: sqlserver-postgres-indexing
plugins.description: Diagnose slow queries and design indexes on SQL Server and PostgreSQL by thinking like the engine. Use for slow queries, execution plans, or index design.

plugins.name: agentic-debugging
plugins.description: Debug code nobody fully understands by separating facts from hypotheses and eliminating causes. Use when an agent's root-cause claim is unproven or a fix didn't work.

plugins.name: agentic-review-loop
plugins.description: Set up, run, and measure a team AI code review loop with a per-reviewer scorecard. Use when designing or tuning AI pull-request review for a team.

plugins.name: agent-orchestration-checklist
plugins.description: Hand big coding tasks to an orchestrator agent and judge the result without reading every line. Use before delegating large work to sub-agents.

plugins.name: impatient-programming
plugins.description: XP's 29 rules rewritten for teams building with coding agents (Impatient Programming). Use when setting up how a team works with agents, tests, and merges.

plugins.name: designite-skills
plugins.description: Designite-style code smell analysis for Java, C#, and Python with open-source tools. Use for design-smell, architecture-smell, or technical-debt reviews.
